subject.title: [Feature]: Support arbitrary workspace files in bootstrap context injection

question: Should OpenClaw support custom-basename bootstrap context through the bundled `bootstrap-extra-files` hook, and is the exact `sessions[sessionKey]` contract from https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/74735 the desired public API?
rationale: The request adds a user-facing startup-context configuration surface, and OpenClaw policy treats new config/default surfaces and prompt/session-state behavior as product and compatibility decisions.

options.title: Approve Exact-Session Contract After Repair
options.body: Let the linked PR remain the landing path once its concrete review blockers and rebase state are resolved, keeping custom basenames explicit and session-scoped.

options.title: Choose A Different Core API
options.body: Keep the issue open but ask for a different config shape, such as a global explicit context-files list or documented hook convention, before implementation proceeds.

options.title: Reject Core Config Expansion
options.body: Close the direction as not planned if maintainers want users to keep this in existing recognized files, custom hooks, or plugin-style context injection instead of core config.

recommendation.title: Approve Exact-Session Contract After Repair
recommendation.body: Let the linked PR remain the landing path once its concrete review blockers and rebase state are resolved, keeping custom basenames explicit and session-scoped.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history ties this owner to boundary-safe bootstrap reads and the relevant hook/config surface.
